errors.error_description: Used bitwise AND '&' between single-bit control signals inside an if condition (en & load) where logical AND '&&' is intended.
Self-instantiated the module with port width mismatches by connecting a WIDTH-bit vector to 1-bit ports (e.g., .load(parallel_in), .shift_in(parallel_in)).
Omitted a semicolon at the end of a logic declaration (logic fsm_glitch) to create a basic syntax violation.
Declared an enum state S_UNUSED but omitted handling for it and provided no default in the case statement.
